steps: For laminate, replace the damaged plank if it's click-lock (may require disassembling the row).
For vinyl, use a color-matched repair kit or seam sealer for small chips.
Clean the area thoroughly before applying any filler or sealant.
Blend repair compound with a putty knife and let cure per instructions.
Buff or polish to match the surrounding sheen.
